description: This Java class 'PersistableOrderPopulator' is responsible for converting 'PersistableOrder' objects into 'Order' entities within the sales management system. It populates order details including customer info, order products, totals, currency, and status, utilizing various services to fetch required data.

classes.name: PersistableOrderPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts PersistableOrder DTOs to Order entities by populating data from suppliers and customer input, including handling order products, totals, customer info, and status history.
